g.text: Reading, filtering, grouping and merging tabular data (DataFrames) across 6 lessons — the most
common data-tidying toolkit beyond Excel. Provider states about 4 hours to the certificate.
Read CSV files and inspect data structures
Handle missing values and merge tables
Basic Python required (provider notes it builds on the Python course).

evaluating, promoting and dismissing staff, and resolving staff grievances;
